theses.subject: Banks

Its crowded_z of 1.9 is a size-down caution only, not a fade. theses.dissent: Banks is the most crowded eligible theme (z 1.9) and the detector's own guardrails warn crowding marks tops on attention spikes; a crowded, late-cycle financials theme in China can unwind sharply when policy support expectations shift.
